scripts.migrate: uv run --directory apps/api alembic upgrade head
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w web && uv run --directory apps/api ruff check && uv run --directory apps/api ruff format --check
scripts.test: npm run test -w web && uv run --directory apps/api pytest
scripts.gen:api: uv run --directory apps/api python -m app.export_openapi > apps/web/openapi.json && npm run gen:api -w web
scripts.check: npm run infra && npm run migrate && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test
